The '''Kudgel''' is a [[Weapons#Clubs|club weapon]] that is a possible reward for the chest on floor 80 of [[the Mines]] if "remixed" mine rewards are selected in the [[Options|Advanced Options]] menu when starting a new game. It is also a possible drop when breaking crates and barrels on floors 100 and deeper in the Mines.

==History==
{{History|1.5|Previously unobtainable weapon introduced as remixed mine reward and crates and barrels drop.}}
{{History|1.6|Raised the critical attack power from +4 to +50.}}
